reason: I already look at magnesium for sleep and recovery after the gym, and the named lab with the batch report behind the QR code is more than most TikTok Shop stuff gives me. $24.99 for the first box is low enough that I'd try one on impulse.
objection: Made in China, so I'm relying on the lab report being real. And it's two capsules every night, which I'll probably forget or get sick of by week two.
would_change_my_mind: If a creator I follow showed the QR code and the real batch report on camera, I'd be more sure. If the price was back at $29.99 with no launch deal and no creator video, I'd scroll past.
